title: Watch How This Blind Man Uses Echo Location To Ride a Bike
summary: A short Inside Edition segment on Daniel Kish, a blind man who uses tongue clicks as human sonar to ride a bicycle through city traffic. He explains that he hears the reflections of the sounds off objects.
why: Cited as a concrete example that humans can learn echolocation, in threads about animal and human sonar.

quote.text: a story of a man who figured it out when he was a child, and eventually learned to ride a bicycle, and started teaching it to others.
